zh.title: 空中巴士H140完成美國高溫高海拔飛行測試
zh.summary: 空中巴士H140完成美國四個月測試，蒐集資料支援認證
body: 空中巴士直升機公司已完成新型H140直升機在美國進行的四個月飛行測試。測試讓這款雙發直升機在氣溫超過攝氏45度及海拔超過13,000英尺的條件下運作，製造商正朝認證及2028年首批客戶交付目標推進。
這項測試於6月13日至10月8日進行，涵蓋美國西南部及洛磯山脈的三處地點。工程人員累計飛行超過130小時，完成逾800次降落，蒐集性能資料，以支援認證並建立直升機獲準的操作範圍。
測試先在亞利桑那州Lake Havasu City進行，6月及7月氣溫達攝氏45度以上。之後，飛機前往科羅拉多州Leadville；當地機場海拔約10,000英尺，測試也在Mount Pennsylvania周邊、海拔超過13,000英尺處進行。第三階段則在新墨西哥州Albuquerque進行，測試環境的密度高度約為7,000至9,000英尺。
工程人員檢視直升機在不同海拔與載重組合下的懸停、起飛及降落表現。高溫會降低空氣密度，進而影響引擎性能及旋翼產生的升力；測試所得資料將用於確認飛機在各種條件下的性能。

en.title: Airbus Helicopters completes H140 hot-and-high tests in the US
en.summary: Airbus Helicopters completes four-month US H140 tests, collecting data to support certification.
body: Airbus Helicopters has completed a four-month flight-test campaign in the United States for its new H140. The twin-engine helicopter was tested in temperatures exceeding 45°C and at altitudes above 13,000 feet. The manufacturer is working towards certification and first customer deliveries in 2028.

The campaign ran from 13 June to 8 October and covered three locations in the American Southwest and Rocky Mountains. Engineers recorded more than 130 flight hours and completed over 800 landings. The work gathered performance data to support certification and establish the helicopter’s approved operating envelope.

Testing began in Lake Havasu City, Arizona, where temperatures reached 45°C and above during June and July. The aircraft then went to Leadville, Colorado, where the airport is approximately 10,000 feet above sea level. Tests also took place around Mount Pennsylvania at altitudes exceeding 13,000 feet. A third phase in Albuquerque, New Mexico, included testing at density altitudes of around 7,000 to 9,000 feet.

Engineers examined hovering, takeoffs and landings under demanding combinations of altitude and payload. The campaign covered hot and high-altitude conditions relevant to establishing aircraft performance data. High temperatures reduce air density, affecting engine performance and the lift produced by rotor blades. Data from the tests are intended to support certification and define the H140’s approved operating envelope.

zh.title: 卡達航空規劃2027年開通多哈直飛西雪梨航班
zh.summary: 卡達航空規劃2027年12月15日開通多哈至西雪梨直飛航班
body: 卡達航空宣佈，計畫自2027年12月15日起開通多哈與 Western Sydney International Airport（WSI）之間的直飛航班。新服務將透過多哈的 Hamad International Airport（DOH），連接卡達航空的全球航網。航空公司表示，初期將每週營運三班往返航班。
多哈飛往西雪梨的航班預定於週一、週三及週五出發，西雪梨返程航班則安排在週二、週四及週六。卡達航空計畫以波音777-300ER執飛新航線，並表示有意逐步增加至每日航班。

en.title: Qatar Airways plans Doha–Western Sydney flights from December 2027
en.summary: Qatar Airways plans Doha–Western Sydney flights from 15 December 2027, initially three return services weekly.
body: Qatar Airways has announced plans to start direct flights between Doha and Western Sydney International Airport (WSI) on 15 December 2027. The service is planned to connect with the airline’s global network through Hamad International Airport (DOH) in Doha. Qatar Airways says it will initially operate three return services each week.

Flights from Doha to Western Sydney are scheduled for Mondays, Wednesdays and Fridays, with return services departing Western Sydney on Tuesdays, Thursdays and Saturdays. The airline plans to use Boeing 777-300ER aircraft on the route and says it intends to progressively increase operations to daily services.

zh.title: 北約將增派巡邏機、雷達與無人機支援黑海監控
zh.summary: 北約將增派黑海地區資產，支援監視、偵察與鑑識工作
body: 北約表示，將向黑海地區增派資產，以支援監視、偵察及鑑識工作。北約發言人在 X（原 Twitter）帳號發文稱，新增資產將包括對上述工作的支援。
美國陸軍上校 Martin Martin L. O’Donnell 引述的說法指出，盟國已派出或將派出海上巡邏機、雷達系統、爆炸物處理小組、情報人員及無人機等前往黑海地區；說法也提到其他資產。

en.title: NATO to Add Patrol Aircraft, Radar and Drones for Black Sea Surveillance
en.summary: NATO plans additional Black Sea assets for surveillance, reconnaissance and forensics support
body: NATO says it will send additional assets to the Black Sea region to support surveillance, reconnaissance and forensics. The NATO spokesperson’s post on X, formerly Twitter, described the planned support in those terms.

A statement attributed to US Army Colonel Martin Martin L. O’Donnell says allies “have or will send” maritime patrol aircraft, radar systems, explosive exploitation teams, intelligence personnel and drones to the Black Sea. The statement also refers to additional assets beyond those named.

zh.title: 利雅德 King Khalid International Airport（RUH）重開 國際航班仍受限
zh.summary: King Khalid International Airport（RUH）已重開，國際航班仍受限且全面復常日期未定
body: 利雅德的 King Khalid International Airport（RUH）於 10 月 18 日重開，結束逾一週的中斷；但國際航班仍遠未恢復正常。航空器營運人仍須事先取得沙烏地阿拉伯民航總局的起降許可。
報導引述 Flightradar24 的更新指出，截至更新時，尚無客運航班申請該許可。全面恢復不受限制的國際客運服務，目前沒有確定日期。

en.title: King Khalid International Airport (RUH) reopens, but Riyadh flights remain restricted
en.summary: King Khalid International Airport (RUH) is open, but international services remain restricted with no full-return date.
body: King Khalid International Airport (RUH) reopened on 18 October after more than a week of disruption, but international flights remain far from normal. Aircraft operators must still obtain prior permission from Saudi Arabia’s General Authority of Civil Aviation to land or depart.

A Flightradar24 update cited in the report said no passenger flight had sought that permission at the time of the update. There is no confirmed date for a full return to unrestricted international passenger services.
